lines.zh: 身材长高了一截，走廊都嫌窄。
lines.en: I have grown a head taller; corridors feel narrow.
My shoulders brush the doorframe.

lines.zh: 头上的角，先于身体到达。
lines.en: My horn arrives before the rest of me.

lines.zh: 这回不飘了，直接用走的。
lines.en: No more drifting. I walk.
My huge shadow sweeps the grass.

lines.zh: 尾巴粗了一圈，扫倒一片草。
lines.en: My thicker tail flattens the grass.

lines.zh: 变化之后，连呼吸都变沉。
lines.en: After the change, even my breath is heavy.

lines.zh: 我把树干撞断了，懒得绕。
lines.en: I snapped a trunk. Not worth going around.
Along the ridge, and rubble rolls down.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就能抓住你。
lines.en: One step closer and I can grab you.
Standing, examining these new hands.
This body is sturdier than before.
I feel the power climbing.
A flick snaps a tree trunk.
A bit of dirt still clings to my horn.
One breath, and the air grows heavy.
I am weighing the next transformation.

lines.zh: 身体变大，动作反而更慢。
lines.en: Bigger body, slower motions.
Just standing, and the birds fall silent.

lines.zh: 这力量，我还得再压一压。
lines.en: I must keep this power in check.
The lines on my hands have deepened.
I look down. You must look up.
My armor has thickened.

lines.zh: 站久了，有点想伸个懒腰。
lines.en: Standing this long makes me want to stretch.
Now, can you still reach me?
I grew. You shrank.
Look up at me, then speak.
You do not even reach my waist.
These eyes are on you.

lines.zh: 别退，退到墙边就没路了。
lines.en: Do not back up. The wall will stop you.

lines.zh: 我抬手就能盖住你的天。
lines.en: I could raise a hand and blot your sky.
Afraid? An honest reaction.
Your ki is still so weak.
From up here, watching you is easy.
Run if you like. You will not get far.

lines.zh: 我这一身肌肉，是变化换来的。
lines.en: This mass came with the change.
Do not look at me. Look at my fist.

lines.zh: 你还站着，倒有几分骨气。
lines.en: Still standing. Some spine, then.

lines.zh: 说话小点声，我耳朵离你很远。
lines.en: Speak louder. My ears are far above you.
Enough height to look down on you.
I am smiling. Should you?
To wound this body at all.
No pain, just irritation.
A dent in the armor.
Half a step back, and the ground cracks.
That one had some merit.
Blood seeps out. Long unseen.
I want to kill you more now.
Bones fine. Armor is not.
I wipe it off and continue.
Painful? Only a little.
Hungry. Changing does that.
That fruit's ki is acceptable.
Hand it up. Do not make me bend.
My appetite is frightening now.
Trade it for your life? We can talk.
Bring more than that.
So little. Who does that feed?
Do not hide it. I can see.

lines.zh: 给得痛快，我就少打你一下。
lines.en: Give it freely and I spare you one blow.
I felt nothing at all.
Back off or you will be stepped on.
My knee is taller than you.
Move. I turn slowly.
Bounced off, did you not?

lines.zh: 这点冲力，连我的甲都没响。
lines.en: Not even my armor rang.
Steady. Do not walk against me.

lines.zh: 你被我的影子碰了一下。
lines.en: My shadow brushed you.

lines.zh: 再挤，我就一只手拎起来。
lines.en: Keep shoving and I will lift you by one arm.
This body is not suited for it.
Ask when I return to my former shape.

lines.zh: 兴致被这具躯壳弄没了。
lines.en: This shell kills the mood.

lines.zh: 宇宙里也没有配得上的。
lines.en: Nor is there an equal in the universe.
Do not ask such things.
I have more important matters.
The horn on my head would get in the way.

lines.zh: 这具身体只为战斗而生。
lines.en: This body exists for battle.
Take your hand away.
A truly dull affair.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，我也得弯腰。
lines.en: Even for this, I must bend.

lines.zh: 手指够不到，用脚踢起来。
lines.en: Fingers cannot reach. I kick it up.
Finally got it. What a bother.
I crushed one by accident.

lines.zh: 这颗珠子，握在手里刚好。
lines.en: This orb fits my palm.
Things on the ground are so small.

lines.zh: 低头的动作，我很不喜欢。
lines.en: Bending my head displeases me.
Whatever I pick up is mine.
A rock. I toss it away.
Aerial combo, ready.
Running will not help now.
The advantage of size is reach.
I will stomp this insect.
I come from above. You cannot block.
This time I have you.
First, I swat you to the ground.
Worth changing shape for this fight.
The wave is charged.
Slow does not mean you can dodge.
I have you in sight. Hold still.
No one here will help you.
This will hurt a great deal.

lines.zh: 来吧，让我看看你有多硬。
lines.en: Come. Let me see how hard you are.
I raise my hand slowly, aimed at you.
Aiming does not take long.
Hiding behind a tree will not help.
This range is exactly one palm.
He moves, and my aim shifts.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸声，你先听见了。
lines.en: You heard my breathing first.
Wait until I say you may.
The blast is hot in my palm.
He thinks I cannot fly.
I will drop from above.
His back is to the wall. Good.
One more beat is enough.
I watch the ground under his feet.
The more panicked the prey, the more openings.
I close this circle off.
My shadow already covers him.
Good. Stay just like that.
One fist, and the ground caves.
The shockwave throws him back.
Aerial combo, first hit.
A palm strike to his chest.
I seize his leg and swing him.
The beam shears a line of trees.
He blocked. His bones cracked.
Second strike, from above.
All this bulk is a weapon.
My tail sweeps, and away he goes.
My horn sticks in the wall. I pull it free.
No rush to kill. First the legs.
The punch lands with a dull thud.
Another hit, and you are still up.
That one was worth it.
I draw back and watch you fall.
I have finally settled into this body.
The change is done. Nothing stops me.

lines.zh: 我踩碎了一块石头落地。
lines.en: I land on a shattered boulder.
Look up. I am taller than the trees.
Is this shape frightening enough?

lines.zh: 第二形态，比第一形态好用。
lines.en: This second form serves better than the first.
The ground trembles briefly.

lines.zh: 从现在起，你们都是猎物。
lines.en: From now on, you are all prey.
When I land, every bird takes flight.

lines.zh: 这地方太小，我伸不开手。
lines.en: Too cramped here for my arms.

lines.zh: 我伸了个懒腰，关节在响。
lines.en: I stretch, and my joints pop.
Who will test this strength first?
Right. Everyone hold your ground.

lines.zh: 我这一身，是给战场准备的。
lines.en: This body was built for a battlefield.

lines.zh: 光是我站在这，土就在沉。
lines.en: Just standing here, the soil sinks.
No fleeing this time. I stay here.

lines.zh: 我的气，压得空气都在抖。
lines.en: My aura makes the air shudder.
The countdown begins now.

lines.zh: 火在甲上烧，像附着的虫。
lines.en: Flame clings to my armor like insects.

lines.zh: 我从高处落地，站得很稳。
lines.en: I land from a height and hold firm.

lines.zh: 水只到我腰，可我不喜欢。
lines.en: Water only to my waist, but I dislike it.

lines.zh: 爆炸声在耳朵里嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The blast buzzes in my ears.
Arrows are too small to find a seam.
This kind of power should not exist.
This body demands too much food.
Current slides off my horn.

lines.zh: 这么大一具身子，掉下去更快。
lines.en: A body this big falls faster.
